answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 700 fakes pays 466 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The tundra is the check that cannot be faked, the vault is the price the attacker pays, and the ridge is the record that outlives the epoch.
